info.text:
The old Ottoman palace was demolished to make room for it

Suleiman the Magnificent commissioned the Süleymaniye Mosque from Mimar Sinan; its inscription dates it 1550 to 1557.

info.text:
Butchers held the shops on this bridge from 1442

A 1565 decree barred butchers from the Ponte Vecchio; today jewellers, art dealers and souvenir sellers hold the shops.

📍 Ponte Vecchio, Florence

Goya has more works here than anyone else

The Prado, founded in 1819, holds Spain's former royal collection; Francisco Goya is its most represented artist.
